Enjoy!

Thank you to all those who bought the game!

notes.title: THE CALL will be going FREE
notes.notes:
The Call will be going Free.
It will no longer be priced, thank you to all who chipped in and bought my game.
Thank you to all those who played it.

The price will be removed in about a week or a month (hopefully).
Now that it will become free, maybe more people will play it.

Thank you everyone for your attention and your support.

notes.notes: Since it's halloween, the game has a discount of -50%! Enjoy!

Pumpkins are pretty sp00ky so we updated the game with a few of them :^)

notes.title: Патч #1
notes.notes:
-"Починили" Невидимые стены. Добавили пропы перед ними (Кусты).

-Два новых достижения. Теперь их Одиннадцать.

-Заменили "Лестницу-доску" на правильную текстуру лестницы.

-Добавили маленкьую отсылку к "некоторым людям".

На сегодня все. Спасибо всем, кто поддержал меня и/или купил мою игру!
Пора спать.

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
-"Fixed" Invisable Walls. Added props infront of them(Bushes).

-Two more achievements. Now there are Eleven in total.

-Replaced "plank ladder" with proper ladder texture.

-Added small reference to "some people".

That's it for today. Thank you to everyone who has supported me and/or bought my game!
Time to sleep.
